attrs.management_says: Organic net sales flat, with favorable price/mix offset by volume declines across major segments (E35, E41, E42, E44, E46, E47, E49).
attrs.numbers_show: Segment commentary consistently cites price/mix gains offset by volume declines in North America Retail, Europe & Australia, and Convenience Stores & Foodservice; only Asia & Latin America shows organic volume growth (E49). This aligns with flat organic sales and the 7% consolidated growth coming from the Pet segment addition.

attrs.management_says: Consolidated net sales rose 7% to $16.9B, primarily reflecting the addition of Blue Buffalo; organic net sales were essentially flat (E32, E33, E34).
attrs.numbers_show: Pet segment (Blue Buffalo) contributed $1,431M of net sales in FY2019 (E51) vs $0 in FY2018 (one-month lag, E50). Total revenue grew $1,124.8M (E1, E12). Other segments declined: North America Retail -2% (E41), Europe & Australia -5% (E46), Convenience Stores & Foodservice +2% (E44), Asia & Latin America -3% (E48). Organic net sales flat per management (E35) matches segment organic trends (E42, E47, E49).

attrs.reason: Segment commentary consistently reports favorable price/mix offsetting volume declines in North America Retail (E41, E42), Europe & Australia (E46, E47), and Convenience Stores & Foodservice (E44), with only Asia & Latin America showing organic volume growth (E49), aligning with flat organic net sales (E35) and 7% consolidated growth from the Pet segment (E51).

This segment-level composition aligns with the 7% consolidated growth coming entirely from the Pet segment addition.
